notes.title: New Update: Vulture Weaponry
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for a great launch week thus far!  Please keep spreading the word!

Age of Grit version 1.2 is now live and contains the Vulture Weaponry Update!  This adds some awesome new weapons for the infamous Vulture Clan--a group of savage sky pirates.  You can find these new brutal weapons in Redbeard Rock, the Vulture home base.  (Note that you won't have access to Redbeard Rock until a certain point in the game.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33701981/9d5020efe54703b2f07c1b4c31ac1aaaa659a918.jpg[/img]

I really appreciate all the support and feedback during this first week!  Please keep it coming!  You can send any input directly to andy@iqsoup.com.  You can also hit F12 at any point in the game into to submit a bug report.  And if you have a minute or two please leave a brief review for the game here on Steam.

Have fun!
- Andy

notes.title: Released version 0.5.1
notes.content:
[b]State of the Game[/b]
Hope everyone is doing well!  Just wanted to bring everyone up to speed on how things are going.  If you're not aware, for some time now our team has had just one member--me!  But I've been doing my best to finish things up on my own and we're now getting mighty close to v1.0 and a full launch of Age of Grit!

What we really need most right now is game testers.  There's only so much useful testing I can do--at this point the entire game just looks like falling green Matrix code to me.  If you'd like to help out please contact me directly at andy@iqsoup.com.  And for everyone out there: any feedback (positive or negative) you can provide would be extremely useful.  Like seriously super useful and helpful!  The game has a built in bug reporter (press F12) so you can easily send us feedback any time you're playing the game.

By the way: Age of Grit is on sale for the rest of the week.  Please tell your friends!

[b]Changelog[/b]
- A TON of dialog improvements.
- Significant story additions. 
- Fixed a bug whereby duels (battles started with an NPC in Town) might not progress properly after a player victory.
- Improved Enemy AI in Battle.
- Now background music will mute temporarily when job complete SFX plays (it sounded weird before).
- Fixed several obscure issues related to the ENGAGE button in the Battle sequence.
- Improved Battle log feedback.
- Fixed a Dialog bug where multiple "CONTINUE" nodes could occasionally appear in a row.
- Improved handling a full inventory when an NPC tried to give you something.  Player now gets an clear Open Inventory node during dialog and a chance to discard items if desired.
- Fixed various text scrolling issues.
- Improved a number of Towns.
- Simplified how Armor Class and Armor Piercing works for the sake of clarity.
- Fixed various minor audio bugs.
- Fixed an issue where player options were occasionally getting cut off under certain conditions.
- Improved ship upgrade items.  Fixed several item specific bugs/issues.
- Fixed Upgrade Area HP counter, which previously wouldn't update under certain conditions.
- Improved keyboard support.  Added keyboard hotkeys to more places.
- Lots of minor fixes and typos.

As always, thanks so much for all the support!

notes.title: Tales from the Frontier - Released version 0.5.0 - New Faction!
notes.content:
Howdy y'all!  I am very proud to announce that Age of Grit has been updated to version 0.5!  This is a MASSIVE update--by far our biggest yet!  There's far too many improvements to mention, but here's some of the main points.

- Added an entire brand new faction to the game: The Compact.  This effectively doubles the game map, adding a huge array of new towns, enemy ships, shops, and NPCs!  Hope you enjoy exploring this huge new area!
- Restructured some of the game's main story line to allow access to the new faction earlier on in the game.
- Added dozens of new ship upgrades: tons of long guns, cannons, flamethrowers, and cannons.
- Added new random encounter events.
- Adjusted battle mechanics.  Now there is better balance various weapon types.  Also improved a number of weapon special abilities.
- Fixed bug with Ammo Delivery quest (in Fort Pinckney) whereby it could not be completed. 
- Numerous dialog and quest edits.
- TONS of other bug fixes, tweaks, and improvements.

Hope you have fun with all the new content!  Feedback is always welcome and appreciated.  Thanks for the support!

notes.title: Tales from the Frontier - Released version 0.4.0!
notes.content:
Howdy!  Hope everyone is doing well.  We've had a lot more players come onboard the last few weeks--welcome to community!

A lot of work went into this update and we are really proud of the progress made.  The main new feature is an Overworld event system.  I think the game is a lot richer now.  The world feels more fleshed out and Overworld travel is a more interesting part of the game.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Added a robust system for random Overworld events!  The system is quite flexible and has broad functionality.  Going forward the task of adding new events will be fairly painless, with a lot of room for variety.  Events come in two main flavors.  First are minor events, these will show up in the Captain's Log.  Second are major events which will have a pop up in their own window.  Often these involve a decision the player will make--for example: toast the Poptart or eat it cold.  The choice is yours!  But honestly, what kind of monster would eat it cold...
- Added TONS of new events to the new system!  These are crammed full of lore.  While events are typically self contained, we've tried to tell stories through events that shed light on the main characters as well as the broader game-world.  Events can be a great way to get loot and will make travel from town to town a little more interesting.
- Various UI improvements.
- Fixed numerous minor bugs/issues.

Thanks for all the support!  We're very grateful for all the feedback and reviews--your suggestions and input are always greatly appreciated! Please contact us anytime at support@iqsoup.com or on Twitter @iqsoup.

notes.title: Tales from the Frontier - v 0.3.1
notes.content:
Hope everyone is staying safe and healthy.  If you're stuck at home all day now might be a great time to try to relax and play some video games.  I hope Age of Grit will provide some fun and entertainment during this crazy time!

We've been hard at work on this update.  There's been some major progress.  Most notably you can now explore the interior of your airship.  Previously all the crew members were on a placeholder "bridge" which was actually just an empty void.  Now you can visit The Bridge, The Armory, The Engine Room, and the Captain's Quarters.  I feel this is a huge improvement and really helps set the vibe for the whole game!

[b]Changelog[/b]
- explore your airship's interior
- added duels--now you can duel certain NPCs you meet in town!
- improved inventory organization - items of different types are now sorted better and easier to distinguish
- added more commodities, items you can buy in one place and sell somewhere else for a profit
- updated the world map in preparation for adding The Compact--a new faction soon to be added to the game
- numerous dialog and quest improvements
- reworked inventory details so information is clearer and better organized
- fixed a bug whereby the inventory screen could sometimes open in the Battle sequence, causing strange graphical issues
- fixed an issue with scrolling the details section in the inventory screen
- fixed various minor bugs and issues

As always we're so thankful for all the feedback and reviews! I can't overstate how extremely valuable your input is! Please contact us anytime at support@iqsoup.com or on Twitter @iqsoup.

notes.title: Tales from the Frontier - v. 0.3.0
notes.content:
Just released version 0.3.0.  We've been hard at work and there's a lot changes--big and small!  Hope you have fun and enjoy!

[b]Changelog[/b]
- tons of dialog improvements - new content and lots of edits.  Expanded some existing quests to provide greater depth and player freedom.
- greatly improved inventory mechanics - things should be a lot more intuitive now.  Also added a new inventory tutorial to help explain things.
- tweaked and balanced a lot of battle mechanics
- improved battle HUD -- added more detailed information regarding ship status
- added HP display to the inventory window so player can see their HP in between battles
- added system for making manual ship repairs via the inventory window
- added new graphics for NPC markers to help differentiate vendors from other NPCs
- lots of minor improvements and bug fixes

A huge thanks for all the feedback and reviews!  I can't overstate how extremely valuable your input is!  Please contact us anytime at support@iqsoup.com or on Twitter @iqsoup.

notes.title: Tales from the Frontier - v. 0.2.8 Update - Steam Winter Sale
notes.content:
Just released version v0.2.8!  This update focuses heavily on increased usability for players.  The game is also currently on sale for 30% for the Steam Winter Sale!  If you've been waiting, now's a great time to pick it up!  And if you know a special someone who likes RPGs--Age of Grit would make the perfect stocking stuffer!  :P

[b]Changelog[/b]
- Added greater keyboard support!  Specifically the Battle sequence can now be fully keyboard controlled!  Currently we're working towards 100% keyboard support for the entire game.  After that will come controller support! :D
- Added tutorials!  This has long been a much needed feature!  Should massively help smooth out the learning curve.
- Further improved intro sequence.
- Fixed various minor issues and bugs.
- Numerous dialog improvements/fixes.

Please contact us anytime at support@iqsoup.com or on Twitter @iqsoup.  We wish you all a merry Christmas, happy holidays, and a great new year!

notes.title: Tales from the Frontier - v. 0.2.7 Update - Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Age of Grit is currently on sale for the Steam Autumn Sale!  This is the cheapest the game has been--a 30% discount!  It's a great time to support the game and pick up a copy (or maybe 10).  Please tell your friends, family, and social media buds!  Thank ya very kindly!

We just released a fairly major update--v. 0.2.7!  This includes an extensive map redesign--the entire face of The West has changed significantly!  The first segment of the game is now dramatically different.  This new map should greatly increase available options and player freedom--especially at the beginning of the game.  We also now start you off on the east side of the map, so that over the course of the game you'll be traveling westward--a la Oregon Trail.  It just seemed to feel better and make more sense thematically.   Finally, we think the new map will fit better with the new playable factions we're working on.

[b]Changelog[/b]
- massive map redesign!!!
- added an opening sequence in Captain Rockwell's personal quarters.  Should give you a better introduction to Rockwell as a character, as well as provide some clues to his past. 
 More coming soon in this vein!
- improved combat feedback, reformatting things and adding a bit of coloration for the sake of readability and clarity
- made important adjustments to the enemy encounter system
- increased dialog speed
- fixed issues with the range circle UI in the Overworld
- fixed a bug where your ship wasn't visible on the Overworld at certain resolutions
- made numerous adjustments to UI for better usability
- numerous dialog improvements; improved job descriptions for clarity

Contact us anytime at support@iqsoup.com or on Twitter @iqsoup.

notes.title: Large Content Update - version 0.2.5
notes.content:
Howdy!  Hope everyone's swell!

We've been hard at work and have just released a great big update for y'all to sink yer chompers into!  There's plenty of new stuff to explore--hope you have fun!

[b]Changelog[/b]
- DOZENS of new airship upgrades: weapons, sensors, hulls, and engines!
- added ability to repair your ship in between towns using spare parts (previously repairs could only occur at a town)
- new side quest: Red Tape
- extensive rebalancing
- tons of dialog edits and fixes

Stay tuned: we have a lot of content, features, and other improvements coming down the pike.  As always your input is very much appreciated so please send your feedback our way!

Thanks for playing our game!

notes.title: New Update - Version 0.2.4
notes.content:
Just posted a new update: v. 02.4!  Lots of new stuff!

[b]Changelog[/b]
- added a new text encounter system.  Now you will get text encounters as you travel across The West.
- added new dialog
- made some major spelling and grammar edits
- fixed a bug where the game would sometimes display the wrong vendor
- fixed a number of saving related issues
- minor UI improvements
- added more content to the Help menu.  Also added some text based tips to add more clarity.
- fixed numerous minor bugs/issues

Another update is already in the works--we are hard at work adding new features, improving the balancing of the game, and cleaning up some of the remaining bugs.

We're super grateful for all feedback we've received!  It's been extremely valuable--you guys are awesome!!!  By the way, if you'd like to email us rather than using the in game bug reporting tool (F12) then please drop us a line at support@iqsoup.com.

Thanks for the support!
